name: boxadm-mcp
description: boxadm-mcp server, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: boxadm-mcp
plugins.description: Box admin-log analytics for Claude Code: external-sharing visibility from Box's enterprise event log (admin_logs) — who shares a lot with the outside, which files get accessed from outside, and a one-shot daily_brief health check. Read-only; never revokes shares, deletes files, or mutates anything.
